Privacy Policy — NDI Monitor

Last updated: September 8, 2026

1. General Information

This Privacy Policy applies to the NDI Monitor application, provided by studiokrause ("Developer").

Privacy contact: studiokrause, Email: devstudiokrause@gmail.com

NDI Monitor is a free application designed to receive and monitor NDI streams within a local network.

2. Data Collection

NDI Monitor does not collect, store, or transmit users' personal data.

The application does not collect, including but not limited to: name or surname, email address, telephone number, location data, contacts, advertising identifiers, device identifiers used to identify the user, application usage data, analytics data, diagnostic data, crash reports.

The application does not use analytics, advertising services, or other external services designed to collect user data.

3. NDI Streams and Audio-Visual Data

NDI Monitor receives NDI streams exclusively within the user's local network.

Audio and video transmitted as part of an NDI stream: are not sent to the Developer, are not sent to external servers, are not transmitted outside the local network as part of the application's operation, are not stored on the device by the application.

The Developer does not have access to the contents of NDI streams received by the user.

4. Network Connections

The application uses Android's network functionality solely to discover and receive NDI streams within the local network.

NDI Monitor does not operate its own server infrastructure for processing user data and does not transmit data to the Developer's servers.

5. Application Permissions

The application may use the following Android permissions and system features: INTERNET — for network communication required to receive NDI streams; ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE — to check network connectivity status; ACCESS_WIFI_STATE — to access information related to Wi-Fi connectivity; CHANGE_WIFI_MULTICAST_STATE — to support multicast communication used by NDI; WAKE_LOCK — to keep the application running while monitoring a stream; FOREGROUND_SERVICE and FOREGROUND_SERVICE_DATA_SYNC — to allow monitoring services to operate when required; POST_NOTIFICATIONS — to display system notifications when this functionality is used by the application.

These permissions are used solely to provide the application's functionality. They are not used to collect users' personal data.

6. Third-Party Services and Data Sharing

NDI Monitor: does not use analytics services, does not display advertisements, does not use external servers for data processing, does not share personal data with third parties, does not sell user data.

The application does not require users to create an account.

7. Data Retention and Deletion

NDI Monitor does not store users' personal data on the Developer's servers.

Because the application does not collect personal data or create user accounts, there is no need for an account or personal data deletion request.

8. Security

The application is designed so that audio and video data received through NDI remains within the user's local network and is not transmitted to the Developer or external services.

9. Children's Privacy

NDI Monitor is not directed at children. It is intended for general users, particularly for technical and professional use.

10. Changes to This Privacy Policy

This Privacy Policy may be updated if the application's functionality, data processing practices, or applicable legal requirements change.

The current version of this Privacy Policy will always be available at the same web address.

11. Contact

If you have any questions regarding privacy or the application, please contact: studiokrause, devstudiokrause@gmail.com
